details: Cryptocurrency exchange Bybit has filed a civil lawsuit in a U.S. federal court against North Korea, its intelligence agency, and the Lazarus Group. The lawsuit seeks to recover approximately $1.5 billion in digital assets stolen in February 2025, which the FBI attributed to North Korea. Bybit has secured a preliminary injunction to prevent the transfer of traced assets as litigation proceeds. The case highlights efforts to combat state-sponsored cybercrime in the crypto space, though a significant portion of the stolen funds (over 90%) remains untraceable. Bybit covered all customer withdrawal requests after the hack, preserving trust.
title: Bybit Sues North Korea Over $1.5 Billion Crypto Hack, Secures Asset Freeze
